toolbar.tip.activity_body: Lists the Git commands Glowfly ran and what they printed.
toolbar.tip.blocked.detached_item: {action} isn't available on a detached HEAD.
toolbar.tip.blocked.detached_merge_reque: Check out a branch to create a merge request
toolbar.tip.blocked.detached_pull: Pull isn't available on a detached HEAD: check out a branch first.
toolbar.tip.blocked.detached_pull_reques: Check out a branch to create a pull request
toolbar.tip.blocked.detached_push: Push isn't available on a detached HEAD: check out a branch first.
toolbar.tip.blocked.no_remote_fetch: This repository has no remote to fetch from.
toolbar.tip.blocked.no_remote_pull: This repository has no remote to pull from.
toolbar.tip.blocked.no_upstream: {branch} has no upstream branch: push it first, or set one from its menu.
toolbar.tip.commands_body: Finds and runs any command, branch or file by name.
toolbar.tip.fetch_all_body: Downloads new commits, branches and tags from every remote; your own branches stay as they are.
toolbar.tip.folder_body: Shows the repository's folder in your file manager.
toolbar.tip.not_loaded: Some of these commits aren't in the loaded history.
toolbar.tip.not_loaded_all: These commits aren't in the loaded history.
toolbar.tip.pop_body: Apply the latest stash and remove it (git stash pop). If it conflicts, the stash is kept.
toolbar.tip.pop_dirty_note: You have local changes: Unstash asks before applying.
toolbar.tip.pr_body: Opens the form; nothing is sent until you create it.
toolbar.tip.publish_body: It has no remote yet: Publish creates one on a hosting service and pushes this branch there.
toolbar.tip.pull_body: Fetches, then fast-forwards when it can and merges when it can't.
toolbar.tip.pull_nothing: Nothing new on {upstream} since the last fetch; pulling checks again.
toolbar.tip.push_behind_note: {upstream} has commits {branch} doesn't; pull first or the push will be refused.
toolbar.tip.push_matching: push.default is matching: a plain push also updates every other branch that has the same name on {remote}.
toolbar.tip.push_mirror: remote.{remote}.mirror is set: a plain push makes {remote} match this repository, deleting refs that aren't here.
toolbar.tip.push_missing_remote: {key} names "{remote}", which isn't a remote here, so Push goes to {dest}, the upstream, instead.
toolbar.tip.push_nothing: Nothing to push: {upstream} has every commit on {branch}.
toolbar.tip.refresh_body: Reads the repository again from disk.
toolbar.tip.search_body: Finds commits by message, author, SHA or path.
toolbar.tip.settings_body: Themes, accounts, keys and Git options.
toolbar.tip.stash_body: Saves your changes, untracked files included, and leaves a clean working tree.
toolbar.tip.terminal_external_body: Right-click to open an external terminal.
toolbar.tip.terminal_tab_body: Right-click for a new terminal tab.
toolbar.undo.name: Undo the last action
